scope: local Qwen TTS browser preparation request schema
claims: Browser preparation accepts only a plain own-property request record.
Node and idempotency identifiers must be non-empty primitive strings and are normalized before submission.
Optional language and instruction controls must be non-empty primitive strings when present.
Unknown fields, including client-supplied execution authority, fail before HTTP submission.
limitations: No Tailnet or Provider request was made.
Real synthesis and retained-media graphical-browser evidence remain gated.
